chunks: And to Midian their brother Shu'aib. He said: 'O my people, worship God; you have no other god but He. And do not diminish the measure and the scale. Indeed, I see you in prosperity, and indeed I fear for you the punishment of an encompassing Day.'

key_terms.شُعَيْباً: Shu'aib, the prophet sent to Midian
key_terms.مَدْيَنَ: Midian, the city/region where Prophet Shu'aib was sent

ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Shu'aib call the people of Midian to do regarding worship and trade?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights Prophet Shu'aib as the 'Qutb' of economic justice, where fair trade is viewed not merely as a civil duty but as a spiritual imperative linked to divine presence. The warning of 'Yawm Muhit' (a comprehensive Day of Judgment) underscores the holistic nature of accountability, where material integrity reflects inner faithfulness to Allah.
